text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ooooooh?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
W-What is this...?
Such a... heartwarming turn of events...
Even for a Make Debut race, this is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "In the early stages, the race unfolded at an easygoing pace, almost as if they were taking a casual stroll together, but..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, the pace picked up in the end,
and every Umamusume crossed the finish line safely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer~. I skipped happily
all the way here~.
choice_data_list: Yeah, they were totally in high spirits...
Yeah, you were in high spirits, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Things just happened to go well today. Everyone matched
Mejiro Bright's pace, which allowed us to turn it into a final-stretch battle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, the higher up you go, the harder it gets to do things at your own tempo.
From races to your entire schedule...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer, is something the matter?
choice_data_list: I have something to discuss about our future schedule.
I have something I'd like to discuss about our future schedule.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Umm~, basically, for a while,
we'll pack my schedule with lo~ts of races...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's best to get used to the hustle and bustle
of the Twinkle Series. Is that what you mean?
choice_data_list: Yeah, as things stand right now, it's a bit much...
Yeah, if things stay as they are, it'll really be tough...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For Mejiro Bright, the major immediate goal will likely be next year's Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Going at one's own pace is fine, but if we keep going with this laid-back mood at this rate, there's a risk we won't make it in time...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, um...
with all due respect~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I don't think that sort of thing really suits me, does it~?
Rather than bustling about in a panic, I prefer to carry myself calmly and grandly~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Why not aim for a magnificent blooming flower?
Like, say, the Hopeful Stakes?
choice_data_list: Aiming for a GⅠ right off the bat!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes~. The Hopeful Stakes... Since it's a GⅠ at the end of the year, there's plenty of time, so I can train calmly, and besides~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
By running in the Hopeful Stakes,
there is a contribution I simply must make, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That would be...
"to bring glory to the Mejiro name."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
From a young age, the Umamusume of the Mejiro family
have continued to believe in this...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "Every Mejiro Umamusume is an 'aspiration.' Every one of them—a child of light."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Still, since I am a slowpoke,
I have not brought even a single ray of light.
Ever since I was a child, I could never win at anything~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: So, I want to enter a GⅠ race as soon as possible and contribute to the Mejiro family~. By any means~, absolutely~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Hearing that makes me think. Going from the Hopeful Stakes
to the Classic GIs is one path, but it requires a certain degree of skill and odds of winning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If you have the confidence and evidence to break through, that's fine, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Confidence... I don't really have that much of it~. But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I believe I must do this.
—As an Umamusume of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her words were soft and airy, yet...
there was a profound gravity in Mejiro Bright's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even without a guarantee, there is a reason.
In that case...
choice_data_list: Got it, then let's enter the Hopeful Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Are you suuuure? Yaaay~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I shall surely run a splendid race~
And bring glory to the Mejiro name~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Taking Mejiro Bright's feelings into account, I decided to take a small gamble. However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Challenging the GⅠ "Hopeful Stakes"
certainly won't be easy.
